scope: Local connection/memory diagnostics. These are selected passing loads, not maximum capacities or official k6/droplet scores.

environment.server: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 Docker VM on Apple M2 Pro

method.load: C epoll generator with feed/post/like/create probabilities and think times from bench/load.js
method.differences_from_k6: Different PRNG and post text; no separate warm-up or ramp-down; thresholds measured during hold.
method.latency: Request latency excludes connect. End-to-end latency includes connect. Reported p95/p99 are the maximum shard percentiles, not pooled percentiles.
method.memory: Process high-water RSS and container memory.current sampled approximately every two seconds, including helper, page cache and kernel memory.
method.cpu: Process user+system CPU divided by wall time. Kernel work on client cores and sampling helper CPU are outside this process value.
method.run_policy: Fresh process/database; cases execute sequentially; same inherited resource limits. Short and long holds are separate diagnostics.

clients.diagnostic: C epoll mixed user loop; not an official k6 score
